Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
Thank you for your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract with the AS-14404 index clause.
To factor in your mentioned volume of 23,700 kg per year, we kindly ask you to share your historical consumption data or a binding release schedule.
In response to your preferred terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.70 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
Thank you for sharing the official forecast; this verified volume allows us to improve our offer.
We can accommodate your request for 60-day payment terms alongside the 24-month contract.
However, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause, as fixed pricing is not feasible, resulting in a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for accepting the AS-14404 index clause, which provides stability for both sides. We truly value our ongoing relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and always aim to offer you the best service and access to our range. However, the base price you propose is too low to cover our operational costs. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We present a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that this Angebot remains valid for 7 days. We hope these terms suit your needs and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
